Ambanis Celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi at Antilia

Mukesh and Nita Ambani celebrated Ganesh Chaturthi at their residence, Antilia. The residence was decorated with a 'white and orange' theme, featuring oranges, a lotus pond, and large lanterns. Radhika Merchant, the younger daughter-in-law, performed a devotional dance. Videos and pictures of the celebration and decorations have circulated widely on social media.
